traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Nepenthaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins entire; veins parallel; blades linear; stipules absent; leaf rosettes none; plants dioecious; ovary superior; stems usually herbaceous, sometimes woody; flowers in panicles, in cymes or in racemes; flowers actinomorphic; perianth tepals; fruit capsule; stamens (2-) 8 to 25; carpels (3-) 4. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
